_note: ['ONE BOARD, FIVE STATES, AND EACH ONE IS JOINED SEPARATELY. Measuring one', "pill and calling the board covered is exactly what boards.json's", '`drift-7-states-board-draws-5` note could not rule out. This recipe joins', '813:4843 (Saving), 813:4849 (Saved · fresh), 813:4861 (Unsaved changes)', 'and 813:4867 (Save failed — retry); the fifth, 813:4855 (Saved · stale),', 'is in `s1-2f-save-indicator-saved-stale`. It has to be a second page', 'because states 2 and 3 are the SAME `saved` branch at two clock positions —', "the board's own caption says so, 'The same saved state as 2, only savedAt", "is older' — so both render the one `save-status-saved` anchor and cannot", 'stand on one page without the target resolving to two elements.', '', 'WHAT MOVED:', '  · `Saved · just now` -> `Saved just now`. The board draws no middot in', "    either saved state, and neither does board 297:1972's topbar", "    ('Saved 2m ago'). Two boards, same answer. The separator was there so", '    the stamp could be dropped at narrow widths, and it still can be —', "    'Saved' alone reads identically with or without it. Two tests asserted", '    the old string and were rewritten in the same change.', '  · `leading-[normal]` on the pill. All five board label nodes are on', '    `leading-[normal]`; `text-xs` was putting 16px on them.', '', 'THE BOARD DRAWS 5, THE COMPONENT HAS 6 (+1 rendering). `conflict` and', "`offline` have no card here — and the board KNOWS: card 4's own caption", "says 'Offline is a SEPARATE state: Offline — not saved'. So this is a", 'board that documents a subset on purpose, not a code surplus. Nothing to', 'conform; the two uncovered states keep their own copy (SaveStatus.tsx', 'carries the reasoning for `offline` — it deliberately does NOT promise a', 'local copy, because a dashboard-backed save writes none).', '', 'NOT JOINED, and why:', "  813:4841 / 4847 / 4859 / 4865 — the 228x40 white bordered 'Frame' each", '  state sits in. That is the SPECIMEN box, not the pill: all five states', "  have an identical one, including 'Save failed', which the shipped", '  component gives a red-tinted pill. A board whose five cards share one', '  container is drawing a catalogue page, not five containers. The shipped', '  pill is h-6/rounded-full, and the topbar boards are where its box is', '  settled.', "  813:4840 / 4844 (and siblings) — the '1. Saving' card titles and the", '  prose under each pill are designer annotation (the LEDGER J-164:22', '  ruling), not product copy.', '  LABEL COLOUR is not in the spec at all and so cannot be joined: the', '  board writes those as bare `text-[#998026]` / `text-[#268c40]` /', '  `text-[#b2661a]` / `text-[#bf2626]`, which extract.mjs does not read as', '  colours. It is a live disagreement worth recording rather than', '  silently winning: the board wants amber/green/orange TEXT for saving,', '  saved-fresh and unsaved; the component makes those three plain', '  `--bk-ink-muted` and lets the dot carry the state (T8/D7 rule 4), and', "  reserves tinted text for the states that mean 'your work is not where", "  you think it is'. Only state 3's colour is in the spec, and there the", '  two agree on `--color/ink-muted`.', '', 'check-board-copy leads, walked: the only REAL one is the ellipsis. The board types "Saving..." (three periods) and the component says "Saving\\u2026" (U+2026), which is the house form everywhere else in the editor ("Reconnecting\\u2026", "Saving\\u2026" in seven settings screens). A typographic normalisation, kept, and recorded here so the lead is not re-opened. The rest are artifacts: "Saved just now" reads as unmatched because the stamp is its own element (the compact tier drops it independently), so the checker sees "Saved" and " just now" as two nodes while the pill renders one string; and every "N. <state>" heading plus its prose is the card\'s designer annotation, not product copy.'] PER-PROPERTY SKIPS 2026-09-08: all four state colours are refused; see each target's skipProps. The geometry and type on every state still compare.

skipProps.color: BOARD PENDING REDRAW (founder call 2026-09-08). The code now paints each state its own ACCESSIBLE token — saved --bk-success-text 5.36, saving --bk-ink-soft 7.56, unsaved --bk-warning-text 8.93, error --bk-error-text on --bk-error-tint 4.89 — which supersedes the component's old 'text-first' rule where all three non-error states painted the same grey. Board 813:4836 asked for four hues that exist as NO token and, three of four, fail AA on white (3.84 / 4.28 / 4.37 against 4.5), so the board is right about the problem and wrong about the fix. This join re-opens the moment the board is redrawn to the tokens; until then the colour is refused rather than conformed to an inaccessible hex.
